title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Sofia Nguyen
description: Context: Customers in regulated industries require strong guarantees that KMS keys used for encrypting customer data are region-resident and that RBAC v2 policies cannot be used to bypass residency controls. This change closes gaps discovered during an audit: 1) missing enforcement path when a resource-level KMS key is annotated for a specific region, 2) insufficient audit events for policy decisions affecting KMS bindings, and 3) lack of migration guidance for existing RBAC v2 roles referencing cross-region keys. Summary of changes: - Add KMS region pinning enforcement in the RBAC v2 enforcer: requests that create or update resources with KMS key references are validated to ensure key.region matches the resource.region or an allowed residency policy. - Emit structured audit events for KMS policy decisions: allow/deny reasons, key fingerprint, policy id, and tenant id are included in audit logs (compliant with our internal audit schema). - Introduce a lightweight migration that flags existing resources with mismatched key residency and emits remediation suggestions (no automatic re-encryption). - Add policy-level override controls restricted to org-admins with an auditable two-step flag (requires both 'org:admin' and 'residency:override' capabilities). - Tests: unit, integration, and e2e harness updates to validate positive/negative flows and rollback behavior. - Docs: updated RBAC v2 security guide and migration playbook for customers. Rollout plan: 1) Feature gated behind feature flag "rbac_v2_kms_region_pin". 2) Canary rollout on Dedicated clusters for customers that opt-in. 3) After 2 weeks of canary telemetry (no critical denials and expected audit volume), flip flag for all Hosted traffic. Migration notes: existing resources with mismatched KMS key regions will be reported to owners via audit events and flagged in the Console. We do not perform automatic re-encryption; customers must re-key resources or update resource region settings per the migration playbook. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is audit-only until the flag is flipped; policy override requires explicit org-admin entitlement. Security review: changes address SEC-103 and were reviewed by security and compliance (see reviewers). Testing performed: unit tests (pkg/kms, pkg/rbac), integration tests against the simulated KMS service, canary run on staging, and manual verification of audit events in the observability stack. Monitoring and alerts: added an alert for spike in RBAC deny events with tag kms_region_mismatch and a dashboard showing deny count, affected tenants, and top offending keys. Ops runbook: included in docs/rbac/v2/kms_region_pinning.md. Related work: follows up on pr-264321 and pr-281234 for KMS residency improvements. Checklist: - [x] Code implemented - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] E2E canary verification - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] Security review - [x] Observability/alerts

review_comments: Devon Park: Can we ensure that the enforcement path only runs for resources that actually reference a KMS key? I saw enforcer.go calls that could be hot in high-throughput paths.
Sofia Nguyen: Good catch - added a short-circuit early return when no KMS reference is present. Also added a micro-benchmark and unit test to ensure latency impact is <0.5ms on hot path.
Liam O'Connor: The audit event includes key fingerprint but not key id. Add both and redact full ARN in logs.
Sofia Nguyen: Added key_id and fingerprint; changed logs to redact full ARN except for last 8 chars per policy. Updated doc for audit schema.
Priya Shah: Migration looks safe, but ops will want a CSV export for owners to drive re-keying. Can you add an export?
Sofia Nguyen: Added an endpoint and console export in this PR; it is gated behind the feature flag.
Security Bot (automated): Snyk found a transitive dependency issue in pkg/audit; upgraded to patched version and re-ran tests.
QA: Found intermittent flakiness in tests/integration/test_kms_region_pinning.go when the simulated KMS returned 503; added retry/backoff in test harness.
Devon Park: Approving after the above fixes. 👍
Liam O'Connor: Approved. Please squash-merge with clear message referencing SEC-103 and ENG-4521.

release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 resources and emit structured audit events for related policy decisions. Feature is feature-flagged (rbac_v2_kms_region_pin) and will be canaried before global rollout. Migration: existing resources with mismatched KMS regions are flagged and owners must re-key or update resource region.
backport_instructions: Backport to release/2026-02 for Dedicated customers needing immediate enforcement. Cherry-pick commits listed in 'commits' and enable feature flag post-backport. Coordinate with security and SRE for canary schedule.
notes: This PR is part of a larger KMS residency hardening effort (see pr-264321, pr-281234). Observability dashboard and an alert were added; SRE to validate thresholds during canary. No automatic re-encryption is performed to avoid data integrity risks.
